market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver currently trades near $30/oz with an all-time high around $50. Reaching $120 would require a >4x rally in ~18 months, a move far outside all historical extremes. Even under a generous 50% annualized volatility, the log-normal probability of hitting $120 by mid-2026 is below 0.5%. The market-implied 6.6% vastly overestimates this tail probability.
evidence_points: Silver spot price ~$30/oz, all-time high ~$50/oz — $120 is unprecedented.
Using a log-normal model with σ=50% and S=30, the prob of exceeding $120 in 1.5y is <0.5%.
The 6.6% market price implies an event roughly 10x more likely than historical extremes and volatility suggest.
